title: The Ferry Between Dar es Salaam and Zanzibar
excerpt: Fast ferries connect Dar es Salaam and Zanzibar several times a day. How it works and when it makes sense.
body:
If you are in Dar es Salaam, the ferry to Zanzibar is a good alternative to flying.

## Duration

The fast ferry takes about two hours.

## Tickets

Buy tickets at the official ferry terminal or through your travel organisation. Avoid touts offering tickets at the port.

## Classes

Economy and higher classes with more comfort. Higher classes are quieter.

## Passport

Bring your passport. Zanzibar has its own arrival procedures.

## Seasickness

The crossing can be rough in windy months. Take precautions if you are sensitive.

## When it makes sense

When you start or end your trip in Dar es Salaam, or combine Zanzibar with a [southern safari](/blog/southern-circuit-tanzania/).

See [Dar es Salaam stopover guide](/blog/dar-es-salaam-guide/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
